blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).
blocks.zh: 我们以人的能力为动力,将不同语言、认知和行动的经验综合起来,引入了UniWALM,一种统一的世界行动语言模式,在单一的共同代表中学习视频、行动和语言,其中每种模式既是调节信号,又是监督目标。 我们问:共同生成语言能丰富这种共同的表述,改善操纵,支持依赖记忆的行为吗? 与以往将推理或视觉语言模型附在视频动作主干线上并作为不同阶段运行的方法不同,UniWALM统一了单一的混合转换器主干线内的所有三种模式,其通式扩散头像动作一样,在没有单独规划阶段的动作中,在同一个通道中,共同隐藏,解码子任务和文字内存;生成的语言在下一个步骤上重新消耗,关闭一个语言-as-memory循环,没有外部规划器或内存库. 为了在这一更加丰富的目标下保持行动流的可靠性,我们进一步引入了 " 流动与校正匹配 " (FMC)这一培训目标,它教人们从扰动的动作轨迹中恢复而无需花费推论时间。 UniWALM在同背骨基线(如FastWAM)上,在构件挑置和位置(英语:MolmoSpaces)上,以及整个依赖内存的子集人民币币(Mypunch)上,不断改进,在没有经过任何预先训练的语言或推理模型的情况下达到34.5%,并且仅使用单一锚架就超过了Mem-0的键框设备设置(28.5%). 在现实世界中寻找项目的任务中,生成文字内存将成功率从11.1%提高到61.1%,而最新技术的VLA则处于或低于机会(QQ33.3%)。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Humans integrate perception, language, and action in an any-to-any manner: regions like the posterior parietal and premotor cortex continuously fuse afferent inputs with efferent motor copies [ 2 ] , and cognitive representations are inherently shaped by what an agent can do in the world [ 19 , 12 ] . For embodied agents, language, video, and action are three complementary views of a single interaction; a unified representation should let each one inform the others: language guiding physical prediction, visual dynamics grounding action, and action anchoring predictions in embodied behavior. Multimodal models have operationalized this framing for vision and text [ 31 , 47 , 55 ] but largely omit action and motor control.
blocks.zh: 人类以任何一种方式融合感知、语言和行动:像后庭和前庭皮层这样的区域不断将活泼的输入与活泼的运动复制件相接 [2] ,认知表达的内在形态是由一种物剂在世界上所能做的事情[19,12]所决定的. 对于被体现的代理,语言,视频,和行动是单一互动的三种互补观点;一个统一的表达方式应该让各自为他人提供参考:语言指导物理预测,视觉动态定位行动,以及动作锁定在被体现的行为中的预测. 多式联运模型已经将这一框架用于视觉和文字[31、47、55],但基本上省略了动作和运动控制。

blocks.en: The same substrate that integrates these modalities also remembers : the hippocampus, which the brain uses to recall past experience, is also recruited to imagine the future and locate the self in time [ 17 , 53 ] . We routinely enlist language itself as working memory (counting out loud, repeating a phone number, silently rehearsing a passage while reading to retain it) to track state through long-horizon, memory-dependent tasks. A truly unified representation should therefore not only let modalities inform one another but also let generated language serve as the working memory that threads behavior across step boundaries. Concretely, because language is co-denoised with action in one representation, the generated string serves as a learned, in-loop plan (next subtask) and textual memory (what has been done so far), while an anchor-frame visual memory preserves scene context across occlusion; re-consumed on the next step, these close a memory loop with no external planner, VLM, or retrieval buffer.
blocks.zh: 整合这些模式的同一种基底也记得:大脑用来回顾过去经验的河马营也被招募来想象未来并及时定位自我[17,53]. 我们经常招募语言本身作为工作记忆(大声计数,重复电话号码,默默地排练一段段落并读取以保留它),通过长视距,依赖记忆的任务来跟踪状态. 因此,真正统一的代表性不仅应让模式相互通报,而且还应让生成的语言作为贯穿跨步骤行为的工作记忆。 具体地说,由于语言与一个表示式中的动作是共同被分化的,所生成的字符串充当了有学问的,内出行计划(下个子任务)和文字内存(到目前为止已经做过的事),而锚定式的视觉内存则保存了整个被封存的场景上下文;在下个步骤上重新被收缩了,它们关闭了一个内存回路,没有外部规划器,VLM,或者检索缓冲.

blocks.en: Recent robotic foundation models connect video, language, and action, but typically along only a subset of these directions. Vision-language-action models [ 36 , 26 ] consume language as fixed conditioning but do not generate it. Chain-of-thought VLAs [ 21 , 6 , 54 , 3 , 56 ] generate intermediate language within a control step, but autoregressively, so action must wait for token decoding, and the generated string is not re-consumed across steps. World-action models (DreamZero [ 51 ] , FastWAM [ 52 ] ) co-model video and action but drop language entirely. Memory-augmented systems [ 42 , 35 , 10 ] attach retrieval buffers or an external planner to a pretrained backbone; π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} [ 35 ] supplies language from a high-level semantic policy while a separate world model generates subgoal images that condition a VLA ( Fig. 1 (f)). On memory-dependent evaluations like RMBench [ 10 ] ’s M ⁡ ( n ) M(n) subset, where decisions require n n task-relevant past observations, policies that condition only on the current frame and prompt collapse.
blocks.zh: 最近的机器人基础模型连接了视频,语言,和行动,但一般只是沿着这些方向的一个子集. 视觉语言-动作模型 [36, 26] 消费语言作为固定条件,但不生成. 思维链 VLA [21, 6, 54, 3, 56] 在一个控制步骤内生成中间语言,但自相递减,所以动作必须等符号解码,生成的字符串不会被跨步骤重接. 世界动作模型 (DreamZero [51], FastWAM [52]) 相模视频和动作,但完全放弃了语言. 内存增强系统[42,35,10] 将检索缓冲器或外部规划器附加到预先训练好的骨干上; ^ 0.7\pi_{0.7}[35] 提供高级语义政策的语言,而单独的世界模型则生成作为VLA条件的子目标图像(图1(f))。 在像人民币[10]的M-(n)M(n)子集这样的依赖内存的评价上,决策需要n任务相关的过去观察,政策只以当前框架为条件,迅速崩溃.

blocks.en: A natural response is to compose a pretrained vision-language model with a video-action backbone and supply reasoning via auxiliary conditioning or an additional loss ( Fig. 1 (f)). This family (hybrid planner + VLA systems [ 35 ] , concurrent compositional WALMs) is more accurately described as WAM + VLM features : it typically uses two vision backbones optimized for different objectives and only loosely coupled, treats language as an external hidden state rather than a generation target, and bolts memory on as a separate retrieval module. UniWALM ( Fig. 1 (g)) uses a single video backbone jointly optimized for all three modalities , with video, action, and language as first-class diffusion heads co-denoised in one pass; the generated language is re-consumed next step, closing a language-as-memory loop with no external planner, VLM, or memory bank. Where prior world-action models supervise the backbone with frame-level predictive structure (future video), UniWALM adds a task-level predictive stream (future subtask and task state as language), a second, longer-horizon supervision signal that frame prediction alone cannot cheaply express.
blocks.zh: 自然反应是用视频动作主干和通过辅助条件进行供应推理来构建一个经过预先训练的视觉语言模型或增加损失(图1(f))。 这个家族(hybrid planner + VLA system [35],并存的成分为WALMs)被更准确地描述为WAM + VLM 特性:它通常使用两个为不同目标而优化的视觉主干并只松散地组合,将语言作为外部隐藏状态而不是一代目标,将内存螺栓作为单独的检索模块. UniWALM(图1 (g)) 使用所有三种模式共同优化的单一视频主干线,视频,动作,和语言作为一流的传播头被同化为一通通;生成的语言被重新收录到下一步,关闭一个没有外部规划器,VLM,或内存库的语言-as-memory循环. 在先前的世界行动模型以帧级预测结构(未来视频)监督主干时,UniWALM会添加任务级预测流(未来子任务和任务状态作为语言),仅帧预测的第二个更长视距监督信号无法廉价地表达.

blocks.en: In this work we study two questions: (i) does jointly generating language enrich the shared representation of a video-action model and improve manipulation? ( Fig. 1 (g)) and (ii) can a policy use its own generated language, re-consumed across steps, as working memory on memory-dependent tasks? ( Fig. 2 )

blocks.en: We introduce UniWALM, a multimodal world-model architecture that takes a step toward any-to-any modeling across language, video, and actions, where each modality serves as both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. Specifically:
blocks.zh: 我们引入了UniWALM, 一种多模式世界模式架构, 它在跨语言、视频和动作的任何模式化上迈出了一步, 每种模式都同时作为调节信号和监督目标。 具体而言:

blocks.en: • World-Action-Language Model (WALM): We introduce WALM, a unified World Action Language Model implemented as a mixture of transformers that takes video, language, and actions as input and generates all three as output. The language stream emits a subtask and textual memory in the same denoising pass as action, and re-consumes them as prompt on the next control step, closing a language-as-memory loop. UniWALM’s language and action experts are trained from scratch on a video-only backbone: no pretrained language or reasoning model is used . • Flow Matching with Correction (FMC). We introduce FMC to improve the reliability of generated actions. During training, FMC perturbs action trajectories and supervises a corrective velocity that returns the perturbed denoising path toward the clean trajectory. This trains recovery from action-space perturbations without adding model capacity or sampling steps at inference. • Evaluation in simulation and real-world manipulation. UniWALM achieves the highest success on all three MolmoSpaces [ 24 ] compositional pick-and-place variants, improving over the same-backbone FastWAM baseline by +14.8% on average ( Tab. 1 ). On RMBench’s memory-dependent M(n) subset, UniWALM reaches 34.5% without pretrained language or reasoning model, improving over same-backbone FastWAM (13.3%) by +21.2 points and above Mem-0’s keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using a single anchor frame instead of per-task privileged keyframes ( Tab. 3 ). On a real-world bimanual Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% (FastWAM, same video backbone, no language) to 61.1% , while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance ( ≤ 33.3 % \leq 33.3\% ) ( Tab. 2 ).
blocks.zh: • 世界行动语言模式: 我们引入了WALM,一个统一的"世界行动语言模型",作为变压器的混合执行,将视频,语言,动作作为输入,生成所有三种作为输出. 语言流释放出一个子任务和文本内存,在与动作相同的去Noing pass中,并在下个控制步骤上重新算出它们作为快取,关闭一个语言-as-memory循环. UniWALM的语言和行动专家从头到尾接受只用视频主干线的培训:没有使用经过预先训练的语言或推理模型. ^ 流与校正相匹配(FMC). 我们引进了妇联以提高所产生的行动的可靠性。 在训练期间,妇联干扰了动作轨迹,并监督了返回扰动去除轨道的矫正速度。 这种训练在不增加模型能力或取样步骤的情况下从行动空间扰动中恢复。 • 在模拟和现实世界操纵中进行评价。 UniWALM在所有三个MolmoSpace[24]组成接地变体上都取得了最大的成功,比同后骨快取WAM基线平均提高14.8%(图一.). 在人民币的依赖内存的M(n)子集上,UniWALM在没有经过预先训练的语言或推理模型的情况下达到了34.5%,比同后骨快取WAM(13.3%)改进为+21.2分并高于Mem-0的密钥帧设备设置(28.5%),使用一个单一的锚框而不是每个任务特权密钥帧(Tab. 3)。 在现实世界的双人项目任务中,生成文字内存将成功率从11.1%(快速WAM,同为视频主干,没有语言)提高到61.1%,而最新水平的VLA则处于或低于偶然性(33.3%\leq 33.3%) (表2)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Generalist robot policies [ 36 , 5 , 14 , 33 , 46 , 6 , 34 , 44 ] improve over single-task models [ 11 , 57 ] by initializing from vision-language backbones [ 49 , 13 , 9 , 39 , 8 , 32 ] and training for action. These policies map observations to actions but do not model world dynamics or reason over long-horizon subtasks.
blocks.zh: 通用机器人政策[36,5,14,33,46,6,34,44] 改进单任务模式[11,57],从视觉语骨干起首发[49,13,9,39,8,32]并进行行动培训. 这些政策描绘了对行动的观察,但并没有将世界的动态或理由作为长期任务的模式。

blocks.en: A recent line of works [ 52 , 51 , 23 , 4 , 16 , 30 , 27 ] adds a video-prediction objective, jointly modeling world dynamics and action. FastWAM [ 52 ] , closest to our work, couples a pretrained Wan2.2 [ 45 ] video DiT with a parallel action DiT through unified attention. These models treat language purely as a conditioning input, never as a generation target and provide no mechanism for subtask reasoning or memory.
blocks.zh: 最近一行作品 [52, 51, 23, 4, 16, 30, 27] 增加了视频预测目标,共同模拟了世界动态和行动. FastWAM [52],最接近我们的工作,夫妇一个预先训练的Wan2.2 [45] 视频DiT,同时通过统一关注动作DiT. 这些模型将语言纯粹当作一个条件输入,从不作为一代目标,也没有为子任务推理或内存提供机制.

blocks.en: Long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks have motivated explicit reasoning and memory [ 10 , 38 ] , and hybrid systems [ 35 , 43 , 7 , 25 , 48 ] that combine a high-level VLM planner, a low-level policy, and a video model to imagine action effects. Because these components are trained separately on heterogeneous data, they lack a shared representation and execute planning and control asynchronously.
blocks.zh: 长视野和依赖记忆的任务激发了明确的推理和记忆[10,38],以及混合系统[35,43,7,25,48]结合了高水平的VLM规划者,低层次政策,以及想象行动效果的视频模型. 由于这些组成部分分别接受不同数据的培训,因此缺乏共同的表述,无法同步进行规划和控制。

blocks.en: Any-to-any modeling originates in multimodal LLMs [ 55 , 47 ] which omit generating actions, and vision works like 4M [ 31 ] , which unify many modalities via masked token modeling but target perception rather than control and do not reason. Concurrent work [ 48 ] additionally generates actions, DINO features, semantics, and video, but cannot reason or preserve memory during manipulation. Concurrent omnimodal models such as Cosmos 3 [ 1 ] extend any-to-any modeling to action within a single framework, but decode text autoregressively in one tower and continuous modalities by diffusion in another, running reasoning and generation as separate stages in a 64B model. UniWALM instead generates language, video, and action entirely by diffusion in one shared representation , denoising language and action synchronously so that reasoning and control co-refine in a single unified model.
blocks.zh: 任何到任何模型都源于省略生成动作的多式联运LLMs[55,47],而视觉效果像4M[31],它通过蒙面的符号模型来统一许多模式,但目标感知而不是控制,没有道理. 同时期工作 [48] 额外生成动作,DINO特性,语义,和视频,但不能在操纵时解释或保存内存. Cosmos 3 [1]等并存的自制模型将任意到任何模型扩展为在一个框架内的行动,但在一个塔内自动地解码出文本,并通过在另一个塔内扩散来不断解码出模式,运行推理和生成在64B模型中作为单独的阶段. UniWALM则完全通过一种共享的表达方式传播语言、视频和动作,

blocks.en: 3 UniWALM
blocks.zh: 3 统一世界妇女运动

blocks.en:
UniWALM jointly models the future video, robot actions, and language within a shared multimodal representation, enabling reasoning and control to be learned together.
Next, we describe its world-action-language formulation, multimodal co-training, and corrective flow-matching objective.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.1 Reasoning with Video Action Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 视频行动模式的理由

blocks.en:
Video Action Models typically map the current observation and a coarse prompt to near-term video and actions, with no explicit mechanism to generate language that can reason about subtasks or maintain task memory.
We introduce UniWALM, a World Action Language Model (WALM) that jointly generates future video, actions, and language within a unified model.
Its language generation expert is a diffusion model that provides language reasoning in the form of subtasks and memory.

我们引入了UniWALM,一个世界行动语言模型(WALM),在一个统一的模型中共同生成未来的视频,行动和语言.

Given a pretrained video model, the observation frames are encoded first and passed through the video DiT.

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-Modal Co-Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 多模式联合培训

blocks.en:
UniWALM trains Video DiT, Action DiT, and Language DiT in a co-training objective that combines the following: ℒ v ​ i ​ d ​ e ​ o := ‖ v t θ v − v t G ​ T v ‖ 1 \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{video}:=||{}^{v}v^{\theta}_{t}-{}^{v}v^{GT}_{t}||_{1} ℒ a ​ c ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n := ‖ v t θ a − v t G ​ T a ‖ 1 \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{action}:=||{}^{a}v^{\theta}_{t}-{}^{a}v^{GT}_{t}||_{1} ℒ := ℒ v ​ i ​ d ​ e ​ o + ℒ a ​ c ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n + α ​ ℒ l ​ a ​ n ​ g \displaystyle\mathcal{L}:=\mathcal{L}_{video}+\mathcal{L}_{action}+\alpha\mathcal{L}_{lang} Here, ℒ v ​ i ​ d ​ e ​ o , ℒ a ​ c ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}_{video},\mathcal{L}_{action} are flow-matching losses; ℒ l ​ a ​ n ​ g \mathcal{L}_{lang} is the discrete diffusion loss ( Sec. 3.1 ).
The v t θ v / a {}^{v/a}v^{\theta}_{t} and v t G ​ T v / a {}^{v/a}v^{GT}_{t} are predicted and ground truth velocities for video/action modality respectively.

We use an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} penalty for the flow-matching terms, which we find more stable than ℓ 2 \ell_{2} for learning actions. Together, these three terms supervise the shared representation at two levels of abstraction in parallel: ℒ v ​ i ​ d ​ e ​ o \mathcal{L}_{video} is frame-level predictive structure (per-step dense RGB prediction, which prior world-action models like FastWAM [ 52 ] and DreamZero [ 51 ] already use), while ℒ l ​ a ​ n ​ g \mathcal{L}_{lang} is task-level predictive structure (future subtask and task state as a short string), a longer-horizon signal that frame prediction alone cannot cheaply express; the action loss anchors both to physical behavior.
Training with both predictive levels in one backbone, rather than only one, is what lets a single end-to-end policy internalize the structure usually externalized to a planner or VLM.
During training, either all or a subset of the mixture of transformers can be trained in tandem depending on the availability of data to reap benefits from all modalities.

blocks.en: 3.3 Memory
blocks.zh: 3.3 记忆

blocks.en: UniWALM integrates three memory mechanisms directly into the shared representation: a textual memory that is re-consumed as the next-step prompt (closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner), a visual memory that admits one or more keyframes, and a task-completion channel that gates when the textual memory is updated. Full implementation details (RoPE-shifted keyframe tokenization, task-completion supervision, and RMBench-specific training configuration) are in Sec. B.4 .
blocks.zh: UniWALM将三个内存机制直接整合到共享的表示中:一个被重新收录为下步快取的文本内存(关闭一个没有外部规划器的语言-即时循环),一个接受一个或多个键框的视觉内存,以及文本内存更新时的闸门任务补全通道. 完整的实施细节(ROPE-转换的关键框架标识、任务完成监督和人民币专用培训配置)载于第B.4节。

blocks.en: Policies that reason once per step cannot carry information across step boundaries, which is exactly what long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks require. At inference, the language head emits a compact string (subtask ∥ \| textual memory) in the same denoising pass as action. For memory-dependent tasks, this string is re-consumed as prompt on the next control step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank.
blocks.zh: 每一步骤一有道理的政策不能跨步传递信息,这正是长期视野和依赖记忆的任务所需要的. 推论,语言头会发出一个紧凑的字符串(subtask QQ textual memory),在与动作相同的去Noing pass中. 对于依赖内存的任务,此字符串在下一个控制步骤上被重演为即时,关闭一个没有外部规划器或内存库的语言-即时循环.

blocks.en: Textual memory alone struggles with scene state that is hard to describe in words (precise object locations, occluded layouts), so we add a lightweight visual-memory stream ℱ \mathcal{F} the policy can always attend to. For tasks that hide or move objects mid-episode, ℱ \mathcal{F} preserves the layout otherwise lost as observations advance.
blocks.zh: 文字记忆单独与场景状态挣扎,在文字中难以描述(精确对象位置,所居地布局),所以我们添加了轻量级可视-记忆流F\mathcal{F}政策总是可以处理的. 对于隐藏或移动对象中集的任务, F\ mathcal{F} 保留在观察推进时丢失的布局 。

blocks.en: If the textual memory is rewritten at every control step, intermediate reasoning overwrites past progress and the summary ceases to be a reliable record of what has been done, especially since the language stream has no explicit supervision for when a subtask is actually complete. We therefore co-train a 1-D task-completion channel β \beta , appended to the action vector, that fires at subtask completion and gates when the textual memory is updated, so the memory advances only at subtask boundaries rather than every step. Because β \beta is concatenated into the action vector, it is supervised jointly with the action by ℒ a ​ c ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}_{action} ( Sec. 3.2 ) and requires no additional loss term.
blocks.zh: 如果每个控制步骤都重写出文字内存,中间推理会覆盖过去的进展,摘要就不再是已经做过的可靠记录,特别是因为语言流对于一个子任务实际完成的时间没有明确的监督. 因此,我们共同训练了一个1-D任务完成通道β\beta,附在动作矢量上,当文字内存更新时,该通道会向子任务完成和闸门发火,所以内存只在子任务边界而不是每个步骤上推进. 由于β\β被凝聚到动作向量中,它与L a ct i o n\ mathcal{L\}_{Action}(第3.2节)的动作一起监督,不需要额外的损失期.

blocks.en: Taken together, these three mechanisms correspond to three distinct learned abstractions over the task that live in the shared representation: the generated subtask is a plan (what to do next), the generated textual memory is a running summary (what has been done), and β \beta is a task-completion signal (when to commit a subtask as done). All three are first-class outputs of the same backbone that generates video and action, not external modules bolted onto a pretrained VLM or retrieval buffer.
blocks.zh: 这三个机制组合起来,对应了三个不同的关于生活在共享代表中的任务的所学取的抽象:生成的子任务是一个计划(下一步要做什么),生成的文本内存是一个运行中的摘要(已经做了什么),而β\β是一个任务完成信号(何时完成一个子任务). 所有三个都是同一主干线的一等输出,生成视频和动作,而不是外部模块被栓入预先训练的VLM或检索缓冲.

blocks.zh: 3.4 流量与校正相匹配(FMC)

During training, a data sample x ∼ p d ​ a ​ t ​ a ​ ( x ) x\sim p_{data}(x) is linearly noised to x t = ( 1 − t ) ​ x + t ​ ϵ x_{t}=(1-t)x+t\epsilon at timestep t t where t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] t\in[0,1] .
The parameterized function learns to estimate the velocity v t := d d ​ t ​ x t = ( ϵ − x ) v_{t}:=\frac{d}{dt}x_{t}=(\epsilon-x) using a mean-square-error objective ‖ v t θ − v t ‖ 2 ||v^{\theta}_{t}-v_{t}||_{2} where v t θ := p θ ​ ( x t , t ) v^{\theta}_{t}:=p_{\theta}(x_{t},t) is the predicted velocity.
Then data is sampled x 1 ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) x_{1}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) and denoised to the clean sample x := x 1 − ∫ 0 1 v t θ ​ 𝑑 t x:=x_{1}-\int_{0}^{1}v^{\theta}_{t}dt .

Flow matching is a ubiquitous objective in training large scale video and action policies because it supports high-quality generation with relatively few sampling steps.
However, policies trained with flow matching often exhibit minor deviations during the generation process resulting in imprecise rollouts.
To curb this, we implement a flow correction strategy that simulates a perturbed noisy trajectory to teach the model to self-correct to a clean denoising trajectory, which we call Flow Matching with Correction (FMC).

流量匹配是培训大规模视频和行动政策的一个无所不在的目标,因为它以相对较少的采样步骤支持高质量的生成.
然而,经过流动匹配培训的政策在生成过程中往往出现小的偏差,导致推出不准确。
为了遏制这种情况,我们实施了一个流校正策略,模拟一个扰动的喧闹轨迹来教导模型自我校正到一个干净的去诺校正轨迹,我们称之为"流校正"(FMC).

It is also related to consistency-style objectives, but differs in its goal: rather than accelerating sampling, FMC trains recovery from local action-space perturbations around the ground-truth trajectory. blocks.en:
UniWALM’s architecture consists of a video prediction backbone [ 45 ] and expands it to add action and language DiTs.
Our action and language DiT models are designed to match the video DiT and have 30 30 layers each.
We reduce the size of the architecture by lowering the hidden dimension resulting in 1B action DiT (hidden dim = 1024 =1024 ) and 0.5 0.5 B language DiT (hidden dim = 512 =512 ). Fig. 4 displays one instance of the MoT layer.
Each modality in the MoT expert layer has its own adaptive layer norm for time conditioning followed by Q Q , K K , V V projection.
These query, key, and value tokens from video, action, and language are concatenated along the token dimension to perform a unified self-attention.
We use RoPE position encoding on the query and key for unified self attention.
The unified self-attention is followed by a cross attention operation that attends video, action, and language (queries) to the task instruction and proprioception (keys).
blocks.zh:
UniWALM的架构由视频预测主干线[45]组成并扩展为添加动作和语言DiTs.
我们的动作和语言DiT模型的设计与视频DiT相匹配,每个有30层.
我们通过降低隐藏的维度来缩小架构的大小,导致1B动作DiT(隐藏暗号=1024=1024)和0.5 B语言DiT(隐藏暗号=512=512). 图4显示了一个 MoT 层的例子.
MOT专家层中的每一种模式都有自己的适应性分层规范,用于时间调节,然后是QQ,KK,VV预测.
这些来自视频、动作和语言的查询、密钥和值符沿符号维度被调和,以便实现统一的自觉。
我们使用RoPE位置编码在查询和密钥上进行统一自我关注.
统一自觉后进行交叉注意力操作,将视频,动作,和语言(queries)到任务指令和自取(键).

blocks.en:
Our approach initializes from a Wan2.2 pretrained model and attaches an action and language DiT expert.
We fine-tune the video backbone with LoRA (rank 256) [ 20 ] , restricting its update to a low-rank subspace.
This reduces trainable parameters and makes optimization easier and more stable on limited data.
During training, we randomly drop proprioception with a probability of 10%, and use a single image as input.
We ensure that the reasoning tokens only attend to the visual features and input prompt and allow the action tokens to attend to the language tokens during generation ( Fig. 2 ).
The model is trained with 8-bit AdamW optimizer [ 29 , 15 ] on 12 H200 nodes with 8 gpus each for 44 hours.
We use an image resolution of 224 x 448 for simulator (two views) and 224 x 672 (three views) for real world experiments.
The language and action DiT are initialized from scratch.
We turn off video generation during inference, similar to FastWAM, and the language DiT runs synchronously with the action DiT.
Unoptimized UniWALM without language generation runs at 76 ms and with the language expert runs at 123 ms to generate an action chunk of 32 with 10 denoising steps.
Our model allows interleaved language generation by caching language features from the last step to choose the frequency of language generation.

On MolmoSpaces ( Tab. 1 ), UniWALM surpasses MolmoBot on all Pick&Place variants by +7% on average without video history, despite using neither video history nor a large-scale pretrained vision-language generator (only the Wan2.2 video backbone is pretrained; language and action DiTs are trained from scratch). blocks.en: On RMBench’s memory-dependent M ⁡ ( n ) M(n) subset ( Tab. 3 , qualitative rollouts in Fig. 6 ), UniWALM succeeds 34.5% on average without any pretrained language or reasoning model , versus 13.3% for same-backbone FastWAM and 5–13% for other memoryless baselines (Mem-0 with its key memory ablated collapses to 4.8%); it also exceeds Mem-0’s keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame rather than per-task privileged keyframes. On RMBench we match the Mem-0 and WLA-0 input setup (visual memory + task-completion channel + textual memory), while using less information: no history keyframes. FastWAM shares our backbone and action-expert size but has no language stream; same-backbone FastWAM reaches only 13.3%, so the +21.2-point RMBench gap is attributable to the language-memory loop and the anchor-frame visual memory, with per-mechanism attribution in Tab. 5 . Concurrent WLA-0 [ 50 ] scores higher but is a pipeline of a pretrained VLM plus a pretrained image-generation model linked via meta-queries; it inherits web-scale language and image-generation priors that UniWALM does not use, and does not form a unified representation. On the real-world Find-the-Item task ( Tab. 2 , rollouts in Fig. 9 ), we use textual memory only (no anchor frame, no task-completion channel) for fairness to the baselines ( π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , GR00T-N1.7, FastWAM, MolmoBot), which have no anchor-frame mechanism; the entire memory signal therefore comes from UniWALM’s own re-consumed language string. Objects are covered mid-episode, so any policy that re-plans from the current frame loses their identities; UniWALM’s re-consumed textual memory retains them across steps, raising success from 11.1% (FastWAM, same video backbone, no language) to 61.1% , while VLA and WAM baselines stay at or below chance ( ≤ 33.3 % \leq 33.3\% ). This gap indicates that generating language reasoning, not action quality alone, drives memory-dependent performance. Per-mechanism attribution of the memory gain is in Sec. 4.1 ; a Press Button failure case is in Appendix B .

blocks.en:
We present UniWALM, a single-representation WALM that jointly denoises video, action, and language, and re-consumes its generated language as working memory for the next control step.
Without any pretrained language or reasoning model, UniWALM achieves state-of-the-art on MolmoSpaces Pick&Place (+14.8 pts over FastWAM), lifts real-world Find-the-Item from 11.1% to 61.1%, and reaches 34.5% on RMBench M ⁡ ( n ) M(n) , exceeding both memoryless baselines and Mem-0 [ 10 ] ’s keyframe-equipped setup while using only a single anchor frame.

blocks.en: Generalist robot policies [ 36 , 5 , 14 , 33 , 46 , 6 , 34 , 44 ] improve over single-task models [ 11 , 57 ] by initializing from vision-language backbones [ 49 , 13 , 9 , 39 , 8 , 32 ] and training for action. These policies map observations to actions but do not model world dynamics or reason over long-horizon subtasks.

blocks.en: A recent line of works [ 52 , 51 , 23 , 4 , 16 , 30 , 27 ] adds a video-prediction objective, jointly modeling world dynamics and action. FastWAM [ 52 ] , closest to our work, couples a pretrained Wan2.2 [ 45 ] video DiT with a parallel action DiT through unified attention. These models treat language purely as a conditioning input, never as a generation target and provide no mechanism for subtask reasoning or memory.
blocks.zh: 最近一行作品 [52, 51, 23, 4, 16, 30, 27] 增加了视频预测目标,共同模拟了世界动态和行动. FastWAM [52],最接近我们的工作,夫妇一个预先训练的Wan2.2 [45] 视频DiT,同时通过统一关注动作DiT. 这些模型将语言纯粹当作一个条件输入,从不作为一代目标,也没有为子任务推理或内存提供机制.

blocks.en: Long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks have motivated explicit reasoning and memory [ 10 , 38 ] , and hybrid systems [ 35 , 43 , 7 , 25 , 48 ] that combine a high-level VLM planner, a low-level policy, and a video model to imagine action effects. Because these components are trained separately on heterogeneous data, they lack a shared representation and execute planning and control asynchronously.
blocks.zh: 长视野和依赖记忆的任务激发了明确的推理和记忆[10,38],以及混合系统[35,43,7,25,48]结合了高水平的VLM规划者,低层次政策,以及想象行动效果的视频模型. 由于这些组成部分分别接受不同数据的培训,因此缺乏共同的表述,无法同步进行规划和控制。

blocks.en:
Any-to-any modeling originates in multimodal LLMs [ 55 , 47 ] which omit generating actions, and vision works like 4M [ 31 ] , which unify many modalities via masked token modeling but target perception rather than control and do not reason.
Concurrent work [ 48 ] additionally generates actions, DINO features, semantics, and video, but cannot reason or preserve memory during manipulation.
Concurrent omnimodal models such as Cosmos 3 [ 1 ] extend any-to-any modeling to action within a single framework, but decode text autoregressively in one tower and continuous modalities by diffusion in another, running reasoning and generation as separate stages in a 64B model.
UniWALM instead generates language, video, and action entirely by diffusion in one shared representation , denoising language and action synchronously so that reasoning and control co-refine in a single unified model.

blocks.en: World-Action Models (WAMs) [ 52 , 51 , 23 ] extend video-generation backbones with a parallel action head so that action prediction can leverage the priors learned by large-scale video pretraining. FastWAM [ 52 ] — the WAM we compare against throughout — initializes from a pretrained Wan2.2 [ 45 ] video DiT and attaches a matched action DiT whose tokens attend to the video tokens through a per-layer unified self-attention, followed by a cross-attention over proprioception and the task prompt. Language is consumed only as fixed conditioning; there is no language expert and no memory over time. UniWALM keeps the same video backbone and unified-attention mechanism but adds (i) a language DiT that co-denoises subtasks and textual memory alongside action, (ii) an anchor-frame visual memory, and (iii) the FMC training objective; the FastWAM-to-UniWALM delta therefore isolates these three additions under matched backbone.

FastWAM [52]——我们与整个WAM的对比——从预先训练的Wan2.2 [45]视频DiT中初始化,并附上一个相匹配的动作DiT,其符符通过每层统一自觉处理视频符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符 语言仅作为固定条件被消耗;没有语言专家,也无记忆随时间推移. blocks.en: MEM [ 42 ] equips a pretrained VLA with mixed-modal memory: a short-horizon stream of recent video frames compressed by a video encoder, and a long-horizon stream of language capturing abstracted semantic progress (e.g., which recipe stages are complete). π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} [ 35 ] builds on the π 0.6 \pi_{0.6} -MEM architecture and inherits the same memory design. Both approaches thus combine visual and textual memory, similar to UniWALM. Two key differences: (i) MEM and π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} attach memory to a pretrained VLM/VLA backbone (autoregressive), whereas UniWALM’s language and action experts are trained from scratch on top of a video-only backbone; and (ii) UniWALM co-denoises language, action, and video synchronously in a single unified diffusion representation, whereas MEM’s long-horizon text summary is produced autoregressively by the pretrained VLM.
blocks.zh: MEM [42] 为预训VLA配备了混合模式内存:由视频编码器压缩的一款近代视频帧的短视流,和一款长视流语言捕捉抽象语义进步(例如,哪些食谱阶段已经完成). ^ 0.7\pi_{0.7} [35] 以 ^ 0.6\pi_{0.6}-MEM架构并继承了同一种内存设计. 这两种方法因此结合了视觉记忆和文字记忆,类似于UniWALM. 两个关键区别是:(一) MEM 和 ^ 0.7\pi_{0.7} 将内存附加在预先训练过的VLM/VLA主干线上(自动递减),而UnWALM的语言和行动专家则从头到尾地训练在一个只录相的主干线上;和(二) UniWALM 将语言,动作和视频同步放在一个单一的统一传播代表中,而MEM的长相程文本摘要则由预先训练的VLM 自动递减地产生.

blocks.en: A closely related line of work generates intermediate language during control: Inner Monologue [ 21 ] , RT-2’s chain-of-thought [ 6 ] , Embodied CoT (ECoT) [ 54 ] , RT-H language action hierarchies [ 3 ] , and CoT-VLA [ 56 ] predict rationales, subtasks, or “language actions” autoregressively and consume them as conditioning for the next action within the same control step. UniWALM differs on three axes. First, language is co-denoised synchronously with action in a single unified diffusion representation rather than produced autoregressively before conditioning. Second, the generated string is re-consumed as prompt on the following control step, closing an explicit memory loop across time rather than serving as within-step reasoning. Third, UniWALM supports both visual memory via anchor frames and textual memory via generated language, whereas the CoT lineage above uses only language-side reasoning. This distinction matters for memory-dependent tasks such as Find-the-Item: policies that reason once per step cannot carry information across step boundaries, whereas UniWALM’s readout persists as retrievable state.
blocks.zh: 一个紧密相联的工作线在控制时生成中间语言: 内部独白 [21],RT-2的连锁思维 [6], Emformical CoT (ECoT) [54],RT-H语言动作等级 [3], CoT-VLA [56] 自动预测原理,子任务,或"语言动作",并将其作为同一控制步骤内下一步行动的前提来消耗. UniWALM在三个轴上有所不同. 首先,语言与行动在单一的统一扩散代表中同步而成,而不是在条件化前自动生成. 第二,生成的字符串在下面的控制步骤上被重新消耗为快取,关闭一个跨时间的明确的内存回路,而不是起到步骤内推理的作用. 第三点 UniWALM既通过锚框支持视觉内存,又通过生成语言支持文字内存,而上方的COT行则只使用语言侧推理. 这种区分对于像Find-the-Project这样的依赖内存的任务很重要:每步一次的理由不能传递跨步边界信息的政策,而UniWALM的读取状态仍然可以检索。

blocks.en: B.2 RMBench Environment and Tasks
blocks.zh: B.2 人民币环境和任务

blocks.en:
The simulation environment for memory tasks uses RMBench [ 10 ] . RMBench organizes memory-dependent manipulation by task memory complexity : M ⁡ ( N ) M(N) denotes the class of tasks whose optimal decisions depend on retaining N N task-relevant past observations, capturing non-local and multi-step temporal dependencies. We evaluate on the four M ⁡ ( N ) M(N) tasks — (1) Press Button, (2) Blocks Ranking Try, (3) Cover Blocks, and (4) Battery Try — which each require repeated exploration or trial-and-error and cannot be solved from the current observation alone. RMBench is built on the RoboTwin 2.0 platform running on the SAPIEN physics engine, with a fixed dual-arm bimanual tabletop workspace using two AgileX arms. For each task we follow RMBench’s protocol of 50 expert demonstrations for training and 100 rollout episodes for evaluation.
Because RMBench requires repeated-attempt, multi-step tracking, we enable the anchor frame and task-completion channel for this benchmark; the MolmoSpaces and real-world experiments do not require them and run without them. Their implementation details are given in Sec. 3.5 .
The following are the task descriptions: • Press Button : press button involves pressing a button based on a count presented above the button. Given three buttons left, middle and right (confirm), the robot needs to read the number shown above left and middle button and press the respective button K times where K is the number displayed above the button.
The robot then needs to press the confirm button.
This task involves remembering the count of button presses followed pressing the confirm button. • Blocks Ranking Try : The scene contains three colored blocks in a random initial arrangement and a confirm button. The task is to discover a specific target permutation by trial: the robot rearranges the blocks, hits the confirm button, receives feedback on whether the arrangement is correct, and repeats. Between attempts, the policy must retain which orderings have already been ruled out so it does not repeat a failed one. • Cover Blocks : The robot faces three colored blocks and three covers. It first places a cover on each block from left to right, then must remove the covers in a fixed color order (red, then green, then blue) and return each cover to where it started. Because the blocks become visually hidden after covering, solving the second phase requires remembering which block was placed under each cover. • Battery Try : A pair of batteries with random initial poses and a two-slot holder are staged on the table. The robot iteratively tries (battery, slot, orientation) combinations until both batteries seat correctly; combinations that previously failed must be recalled so the same attempt is not repeated.

blocks.en: B.4 Memory Architecture Details
blocks.zh: B.4 内存结构细节

blocks.en: The following architecture choices for UniWALM’s memory channels apply across all benchmarks, independent of the specific evaluation setup.
blocks.zh: 以下UniWALM内存通道的架构选择适用于所有基准,独立于具体的评价设置.

blocks.en: UniWALM conditions on one or more visual-memory keyframes captured during the episode. In our current experiments we use a single anchor frame ℱ \mathcal{F} taken at episode start, which provides a persistent visual reference of the initial scene layout (e.g., pre-occlusion object positions) that is otherwise lost as later observations advance. Each visual-memory frame is passed through the same VAE encoder as the current observation and concatenated along the token dimension into the video stream, so the language and action DiTs attend to it via the shared unified self-attention. To avoid position-encoding overlap with the current observation, we shift the RoPE [ 41 ] coordinates of each visual-memory frame by the frame width W W and vary the 0 th RoPE coordinate based on video timestep. The design accepts an arbitrary number of frames (e.g., a bank of task-relevant keyframes selected online), but we defer multi-frame visual memory to future work. Because the visual-memory keyframes and the observation are on separate RoPE grids, adding or removing memory frames does not change the network’s parameter count or interface; it only changes the number of memory tokens attended to.
blocks.zh: UniWALM在剧集中捕捉到的一个或多个视觉-记忆键框上的条件. 在目前的实验中,我们使用一个在剧集开场时拍摄的单个锚定框F\mathcal{F},这为最初的场景布局(如预隔离对象位置)提供了一个持续的视觉参考,否则会随着后期观测的推进而丢失. 每个视觉-记忆相框通过与当前观察相同的VAE编码器并沿符号维相接而入视频流,因此语言和动作DiTs通过共享的统一自觉来关注. 为了避免位置编码与当前观测重叠,我们将每个可视相模帧的ROPE [41]坐标由帧宽W W移出,并基于视频时序来改变0th RoPE坐标. 设计接受任意数量的帧(例如在线选择的任务相关密钥帧的库),但我们将多帧视觉内存推迟到未来工作. 由于可视-相模密钥框和观测在单独的ROPE网格上,添加或去除内存框不会改变网络的参数计数或接口;它只会改变所处理的内存符数.

blocks.en: B.6 Failure Case: Press Button
blocks.zh: B.6 失败案例:按键

blocks.en: We observe cases where the language-memory loop tracks state correctly but the action executor over- or under-shoots by one press. On a Press Button episode with target counts ( left = 5 , middle = 2 , confirm = 1 ) (\text{left}=5,\text{middle}=2,\text{confirm}=1) , the memory readout progresses cleanly to left 5/5, middle 2/2, confirm, next: done , yet the physical arm registers three middle presses instead of two ( Fig. 12 ). The internal count is right; the task-completion channel fires one step late, so the action expert continues the current subtask for one extra press.
blocks.zh: 我们观察的是语言-记忆回路音轨的正确状态,但动作执行器被一个被压住或射出不足。 在有目标计数(左=5,中=2,确认=1) (\text{左=5,\text{中=2,\text{确认=1)的按键集上,内存读取过程清晰地向左为5/5,中为2/2,确认下为:完成,然而物理臂录取了3个中键而不是2个(图12). 内部计数是正确的;任务完成通道晚点放出一步,所以行动专家继续当前的子任务,再加出一副.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Timing-lag failure on Press Button. Target counts are ( left = 5 , middle = 2 , confirm = 1 ) (\text{left}=5,\text{middle}=2,\text{confirm}=1) . The memory readout tracks the intended count correctly ( left 5/5, middle 2/2, confirm, next: done ), but the action executor over-shoots by one press on middle, yielding 3 physical middle presses instead of 2. The language-memory loop is correct; the task-completion channel fires one step late, so the action expert continues the current subtask for one extra press.

blocks.en: Appendix C Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录C 限制

blocks.en: UniWALM exhibits four main failure modes. (i) Boundary misfires : the memory loop tracks state correctly but the task-completion signal β \beta fires one step late or early, causing an extra or missed press ( Fig. 12 ; detailed case in the Failure Case subsection above). (ii) Incorrect subtask prediction : on near-identical observations with different underlying memory state, the language stream occasionally emits the wrong next subtask. (iii) Grasp precision : complex-geometry objects and cluttered scenes still bound task success. (iv) Inference speed : generating an action chunk of 32 with the language expert at 10 denoising steps runs at 123 ms (76 ms without language; Sec. 3.5 ), which may be too slow for high-frequency closed-loop control.
blocks.zh: UniWALM 显示四种主要失败模式 。 (一) 边界误射:内存回路轨状态正确,但任务完成信号β\beta发射出后一步或更早,造成额外或错失了压力(图12;上文 " 失败 " 小节中的详细案例)。 (二)不正确的子任务预测 : 在具有不同内存状态的近同音观察中,语言流偶尔会发出错误的下个子任务. (三) Grasp精度 :复杂地几何物体和杂乱的场景仍被绑定任务成功. (四)推论速度:与语言专家在10个去诺音阶下产生一个32个动作块,以123ms(76ms无语言;3.5sec.)运行,这对于高频闭路控制可能太慢.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 未来工作

blocks.en: Beyond the directions in the main paper, the UniWALM formulation opens several concrete extensions.
blocks.zh: 除正文方向外,UniWALM配方开启了多条具体扩展.

blocks.en: Our language DiT is trained from scratch. Initializing it from a pretrained vision-language model would inject broad semantic priors into the language-memory loop without altering the shared-denoising interface.
blocks.zh: 我们的语言DiT是从零开始训练的. 从预先训练的视觉语言模型中初始化,可以向语言-记忆回路注入广义的语义前缀而不会改变共享-识别界面.

blocks.en: The current textual memory is a single running string. Coupling it with an external episode log and a learned selection policy (choosing which past states or memory snippets to re-inject into the prompt) would extend the loop to long horizons and cross-episode settings.
blocks.zh: 目前的文字内存是单一运行的字符串. 将它与外部的插曲日志和学习到的选择政策相配合(选择哪个过去状态或内存片段重新注入到快件中),将循环扩展到长视野和跨集设置.

blocks.en: FMC currently perturbs clean actions with Gaussian noise ϵ 1 \epsilon_{1} . A stronger variant is to construct the perturbation from the model’s actual rollout deviations: store rollout error pairs and train the correction target to recover the nominal path from these empirical errors rather than synthetic noise.
blocks.zh: FMC目前用高斯噪音干扰了干净的动作, 一个更强大的变体是从模型的实际推出偏差中构建出扰动:存储推出出错对并训练校正目标,以从这些经验性错误中取回标称路径而不是合成噪音.

blocks.en: A learned confidence head c ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] c\in(0,1] over the predicted velocity, trained jointly with a log-penalty to prevent trivial collapse, would let the policy down-weight uncertain action predictions and expose an inference-time signal for guarded execution and targeted re-planning.
blocks.zh: 学来的信心头(0, 1) c\in (0, 1) 对预测速度进行联合训练, 防止微小倒塌, 让政策降低重量的不确定动作预测,

blocks.en: Our visual-memory stream already supports an arbitrary number of frames ( Sec. 3.5 ), but our experiments use a single anchor frame. A natural extension is to maintain a running history of keyframes (either at fixed intervals or selected online by the model) so the policy can attend to a bank of task-relevant past observations rather than a single snapshot at episode start.
blocks.zh: 我们的视觉-记忆流已经支持任意数量的帧数(第3.5节),但我们的实验使用单一的锚数帧. 一个自然的延伸是保持一个按键帧的运行历史(无论是固定的间隔还是由模型在线选择),这样政策就可以处理一库与任务相关的过去观察,而不是在插曲开始时的单一快照.

blocks.en: When several conditioning streams are provided (e.g., a multi-keyframe visual-memory history, textual memory, current observation, and proprioception), careful training is required to prevent the policy from shortcutting to whichever stream is most predictive on the training distribution and ignoring the rest: for instance, collapsing onto the most recent keyframe while ignoring earlier ones, or ignoring the textual memory when the current frame alone is sufficient in-distribution. Explicit stream dropout, per-stream masking curricula, and information-theoretic regularizers that encourage the action expert to attend to the situation-relevant signal are promising directions for scaling UniWALM to richer memory and observation channels.
blocks.zh: 当提供多个调制流时(例如多键框架可视化-记忆历史,文本内存,当前观察,以及自发性),需要进行认真的培训来防止政策从短切切到训练分布上最能预测的哪个流而忽略其他:例如,崩溃到最近的键框架而忽略了更早的键,或者当当前框架本身足够分散时忽略文本内存. 明确的流出、每流的遮掩课程以及鼓励行动专家注意与情况有关的信号的信息理论常态器,是将UniWALM推广到更丰富的内存和观察渠道的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Because UniWALM emits the next subtask and textual memory before the corresponding action is executed, the generated string is effectively a human-readable trace of the robot’s intention. This exposes a natural handle for safe deployment: downstream guards can veto or re-plan when the declared intention violates a constraint, operators can audit rollouts via the language log, and the trace supplies dense data for intention-conditioned alignment. Making this trace faithful (grounded in the actually-executed action), tamper-resistant, and expressive enough to cover safety-critical constraints is an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 由于UniWALM在相应动作执行之前释放出下个子任务和文字内存,生成的字符串实际上是机器人意图的可被人读取的痕迹. 这暴露出安全部署的自然手柄:当宣布的意图违反限制时下游警卫可以否决或重新计划,运营商可以通过语言日志来审计推出,而跟踪为意图有条件的匹配提供密集数据. 使这种追踪忠实(以实际执行的行动为基础),能抵御篡改并足以涵盖安全关键限制的表达力,是未来研究的一个重要方向.
